actions.create-article.description: Creates a new article in your Help Center.

actions.create-or-update-company.descrip: Creates a new company or updates an existing one (matched by Company ID).

actions.create-or-update-company.props.m: How much revenue the company generates for your business (whole integers only).
actions.create-or-update-company.props.r: The time the company was created by you.
actions.create-or-update-company.props.s: The number of employees in this company.

The article content. HTML is allowed.
The Help Center collection to put the article in. Leave empty for none.

The contact ID, email or external ID, matching Identify Contact By. An unknown email creates a new contact.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).

actions.search_contacts.props.startingAf: The next_starting_after value from the previous page.
actions.search_contacts.props.updatedAft: Intercom compares dates by calendar day in your workspace time zone.

actions.search_conversations.props.advan: Optional Intercom search filter, combined with the fields above using AND.

actions.set_conversation_state.props.clo: Optional, Close only. The customer sees this message.
